summary: Log why an incremental projection fell back to a full replay

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild is added or avoided. Only diagnostics change: a failed incremental projection logs one extra bounded line (error code and message, the first eight claim kinds of the range, the range) before the existing full-replay line, and an operation conflict logs the operation id, its stored state, whether the digests differ and the claim kind.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. The existing full-replay line is unchanged; tooling that matches log lines sees one additional line before it.
